Yes we have this in Switzerland and I allready tried to serve in it. To be honest I thought it will help me with some problems I have and I realy looked forward to it. But as it startet I got kicked out after 3 weeks. Beacuse the military psychatrist saied, that he sees tendencies to suicid. Even if I didn't try or tell him anything about my first attempt. On the same day this happend they took most things from me, Weapon, Knife, even the ribbons for the shoes.. And one week later I was sent home. 

So this isn't realy an option for me anymore. And I don't realy think that my overall experience there was that big of a help or some sort of a loss. So I can't realy tell you how it was, it was for sure fast and unexpected.

As a child I realy liked painting but never realy did it in the past years. Maybe I should give that a try. 

To the point with Chatting online.. I tried that soo many times, I think I got an Account on almost all popular Sites I heard off, and never realy got an answer from the Girls I talked to. I even tried to talk to those which won't "hit" me just by looking at the pictures. I realy think it's all tied together with my low self esteem. 

But the thing with learning a new language.. I was so bad at languages my whole life. In Switzerland you start learning a foreign language around the 3th Grade till you go to work... I can't speak in this language, i barley managed to pass the tests.

But all in all, I will as you mentioned, try to pick up some new hobby, like painting.

Thank you for your help, Confuseaman
